audit.shootout_policy: Penalty-shootout attempts are excluded. Regular-time and extra-time match penalties are evaluated as role evidence.
audit.absence_policy: A taker's absence does not automatically promote the player who took in his absence.
audit.social_media_policy: X and Reddit were used as discovery leads only. No social-only claim determines a verdict.
audit.confidence_definition: Confidence measures confidence in the recommended hierarchy, not the player's penalty-taking ability.

priority_definitions.P0: Publish blocker: filed primary is absent, hierarchy is blank, or the current hierarchy is materially wrong.
priority_definitions.P1: Material correction or availability condition that should be resolved before the relevant matchday.
priority_definitions.P2: Filed primary can remain, but backup depth or conditions require monitoring.

verdict.summary: The filed primary left in January. Lucas Boyé has both post-transfer specialist support and a subsequent regular-time conversion ahead of Toni Martínez.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved.

evidence.title: Carlos Vicente transferred to Birmingham City
evidence.summary: The permanent transfer ended Carlos Vicente's spell at Alavés, so he cannot remain in the 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: Post-transfer responsibility assigned to Lucas Boyé
evidence.summary: The specialist review explicitly placed penalty responsibility with Lucas Boyé after Carlos Vicente's winter departure.

evidence.title: Lucas Boyé converts at Mestalla
evidence.summary: Boyé converted a regular-time penalty against Valencia with Toni Martínez starting, directly supporting Boyé above Martínez.

verdict.summary: Oihan Sancet remains supported as primary. Guruzeta has demonstrated cover only after Sancet left the pitch, while the order between Guruzeta and Nico Williams is not established.

clubs.recommended_notes: The backup order is unresolved between Gorka Guruzeta and Nico Williams.

evidence.title: Oihan Sancet converts an early-season league penalty
evidence.summary: Sancet's documented conversion supports his position as the incumbent primary taker.

evidence.title: Guruzeta converts after Sancet is substituted
evidence.summary: Guruzeta converted after Sancet had been substituted. The event establishes Guruzeta as cover but does not displace Sancet or prove the full backup order.

verdict.summary: Julián Álvarez remains the supported primary while he remains at the club. Antoine Griezmann has left, and Sørloth cannot be promoted solely because of that departure.

clubs.recommended_notes: Both backup positions are unresolved. Recheck immediately if Julián Álvarez leaves.

evidence.title: Julián Álvarez converts against Arsenal
evidence.summary: Álvarez converted a regular-time penalty in the Champions League semifinal first leg, providing recent high-level role evidence.

evidence.title: Antoine Griezmann's summer departure announced
evidence.summary: Griezmann's move to Orlando removes him from the 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: Julián Álvarez remains subject to transfer reporting
evidence.summary: Álvarez remained at Atlético at the audit cutoff, but active transfer reporting makes the recommendation conditional on his continued registration.

verdict.summary: The evidence supports a discretionary three-player committee rather than a stable linear hierarchy.

clubs.recommended_notes: These names form an unordered committee. Their array position is not a claimed fixed sequence.

evidence.title: Penalty management described as discretionary
evidence.summary: Reporting described penalty management as free rather than fixed. Raphinha had taken the previous two attempts before Lamine Yamal's subsequent attempt.

evidence.title: Three-player penalty record reviewed
evidence.summary: Lamine took the most penalties in 2025/26, Raphinha recorded a perfect conversion rate, and Lewandowski missed two of three. The mixed usage supports a committee rather than the filed sequence.

verdict.summary: The filed order is supported by a complete regular-time season review and specialist consensus.

clubs.recommended_notes: Retain the filed hierarchy.

evidence.title: Celta finishes with a perfect regular-time penalty record
evidence.summary: The report recorded nine conversions from nine regular-time penalties: Borja Iglesias four, Iago Aspas two, Marcos Alonso one, and one each for two other players. It separately identified Copa shootout misses, which are excluded.

evidence.title: Borja Iglesias listed as first-choice taker
evidence.summary: The specialist review independently placed Borja Iglesias first.

verdict.summary: Yeremay Hernández is strongly supported as primary, but the promoted club's backup order is not established.

clubs.recommended_notes: Both backup positions are unresolved.

evidence.title: Yeremay converts the winner against Cultural Leonesa
evidence.summary: Yeremay converted the winning regular-time league penalty.

evidence.title: Yeremay remains the documented taker
evidence.summary: The club history records further 2025/26 attempts by Yeremay, including the latest listed April event.

evidence.title: Yeremay confirms contract through 2030
evidence.summary: Yeremay stated that he remained a Deportivo player under contract through 2030.

verdict.summary: Both evidenced takers have left. Aleix Febas cannot be promoted merely because the players above him departed.

clubs.recommended_notes: The entire current hierarchy is unresolved.

evidence.title: André Silva converts before Rafa Mir enters
evidence.summary: Silva converted while Mir was not on the pitch. This established Silva as cover at that time, not precedence over Mir.

evidence.title: André Silva converts against Atlético
evidence.summary: Silva converted another regular-time penalty late in the season.

evidence.title: André Silva leaves for Porto
evidence.summary: Silva's departure removed him from the 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: Rafa Mir's association with the club terminated
evidence.summary: The termination removed Mir from the 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: No successor emerges in the depleted preseason attack
evidence.summary: The preseason report described the attack as depleted after the departures of Álvaro Rodríguez, Rafa Mir, and André Silva, without identifying a new penalty taker.

verdict.summary: Kike García has the strongest current primary evidence. Javi Puado and Roberto Fernández remain an unordered cover pool.

clubs.recommended_notes: The backup order is unresolved between Javi Puado and Roberto Fernández.

evidence.title: Javi Puado converts a retaken penalty
evidence.summary: Puado converted before Kike García joined, so the event does not establish precedence over the later signing.

evidence.title: Kike García converts against Mallorca
evidence.summary: Kike converted with Puado involved in the match, providing the strongest direct evidence against Puado remaining undisputed first choice.

evidence.title: Kike García takes the later league penalty
evidence.summary: Kike took and missed the later league penalty. A miss alone does not remove him from the role.

verdict.summary: Mauro Arambarri has left and Martín Satriano has been explicitly assigned specialist status during preseason.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved.

evidence.title: Mauro Arambarri leaves in the summer squad changes
evidence.summary: Arambarri's departure removes the filed primary from the current hierarchy.

evidence.title: Martín Satriano assumes penalty responsibility
evidence.summary: Satriano converted against Tenerife and was explicitly described as the new specialist after Arambarri and Luis Milla left.

evidence.title: Borja Mayoral remains contracted for 2026/27
evidence.summary: Mayoral's continuing contract supports retaining him as a current backup candidate rather than primary.

verdict.summary: Morales has left. Adrián de la Fuente has demonstrated cover, but the event occurred without Morales and does not prove inherited first-choice status.

clubs.recommended_notes: The hierarchy is unresolved. Adrián de la Fuente is the best-evidenced current candidate.

evidence.title: Morales converts against Barcelona
evidence.summary: Morales was the evidenced incumbent during 2025/26.

evidence.title: Adrián de la Fuente takes against Getafe
evidence.summary: De la Fuente took and missed with Morales unavailable; Etta Eyong entered later. This proves candidacy but not permanent succession.

evidence.title: José Morales and Levante part ways
evidence.summary: The club announcement removes Morales from the 2026/27 hierarchy.

verdict.summary: Chupe remained the taker despite mid-season misses. Adrián Niño has supporting specialist evidence, but the third position is unresolved.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved.

evidence.title: Chupe's role questioned after consecutive misses
evidence.summary: Chupe had taken the preceding penalties despite two consecutive misses. The report questioned whether he would retain the next attempt but did not establish a replacement.

evidence.title: Chupe continues taking penalties after the misses
evidence.summary: The event history records Chupe taking further penalties on May 2 and May 31, demonstrating that the earlier misses did not immediately remove him.

evidence.title: Chupe's role reaffirmed and Adrián Niño identified as a specialist
evidence.summary: The report reaffirmed Chupe's penalty contribution and identified Adrián Niño as another capable specialist.

evidence.title: Chupe remains in the promoted preseason squad
evidence.summary: The preseason report confirms Chupe remained with the squad at the audit cutoff.

verdict.summary: Ante Budimir remains strongly supported as primary. The filed backup sequence lacks sufficient direct current evidence.

clubs.recommended_notes: Both backup positions are unresolved.

evidence.title: Ante Budimir converts against Real Madrid
evidence.summary: Budimir won and converted the regular-time penalty.

evidence.title: Budimir takes the penalty against Athletic
evidence.summary: Budimir took the later penalty and had it saved. A miss does not by itself remove the role.

evidence.title: Budimir remains part of the current squad
evidence.summary: The preseason report expected Budimir's return and provided no evidence of a hierarchy change.

verdict.summary: Andrés Martín is strongly supported as primary through repeated regular-time conversions, including with another attacking candidate on the pitch.

clubs.recommended_notes: Both backup positions are unresolved.

evidence.title: Andrés Martín converts at Valladolid
evidence.summary: Andrés converted with Juan Carlos Arana also on the pitch, providing useful direct hierarchy evidence.

evidence.title: Andrés Martín converts in the promotion-clinching match
evidence.summary: Andrés converted another high-pressure regular-time penalty in the match that secured promotion.

evidence.title: Andrés remains with the promoted squad
evidence.summary: The preseason report confirms Andrés remained in the squad at the audit cutoff.

verdict.summary: Isi Palazón remains the supported primary and Jorge de Frutos is demonstrated cover. The third position is unsupported, and Isi's suspension requires an availability check.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved. Temporary suspension absence must not be treated as permanent promotion for De Frutos.

evidence.title: Isi remains the repeated taker before De Frutos covers
evidence.summary: The event history records multiple league attempts by Isi before Jorge de Frutos took the March penalty.

evidence.title: Jorge de Frutos converts against Oviedo
evidence.summary: De Frutos converted, establishing him as demonstrated cover without proving a permanent change above Isi.

evidence.title: Isi Palazón receives a seven-match suspension
evidence.summary: The ban was issued with fewer than seven league rounds remaining, so availability at the start of 2026/27 requires confirmation. This is an availability condition, not hierarchy evidence.

verdict.summary: Cucho Hernández remains the supported primary. Ezequiel Ávila has left, and Antony cannot be promoted without direct role evidence.

clubs.recommended_notes: Both backup positions are unresolved.

evidence.title: Cucho Hernández converts against Braga
evidence.summary: Cucho converted a regular-time penalty in the Europa League quarterfinal, providing recent high-level primary evidence.

evidence.title: Ezequiel Ávila's departure confirmed
evidence.summary: Ávila's departure removes him from the filed 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: Cucho remains the expected attacking reference
evidence.summary: Cucho remained part of the current squad and no source established a different primary.

verdict.summary: Kylian Mbappé is the supported first option. Current evidence does not establish a fixed order between Vinícius Júnior and Jude Bellingham.

clubs.recommended_notes: The backup order is unresolved between Vinícius Júnior and Jude Bellingham.

evidence.title: Mbappé identified as the designated first taker
evidence.summary: Contemporary reporting stated that Mbappé was the designated first option.

evidence.title: Mbappé converts and remains first option
evidence.summary: Mbappé converted against Rayo and was again described as first option. The article documented attempts by all three players without establishing a fixed backup sequence.

verdict.summary: Mikel Oyarzabal remains primary and Brais Méndez is demonstrated second-choice or delegated cover. Takefusa Kubo lacks direct current penalty-role evidence.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved.

evidence.title: Brais Méndez converts while Oyarzabal participates
evidence.summary: Brais converted a late penalty while Oyarzabal had played and scored, establishing genuine delegation or cover rather than a simple absence event.

evidence.title: Oyarzabal takes the later listed penalty
evidence.summary: Oyarzabal subsequently took the later listed penalty, supporting his retention as primary above Brais.

evidence.title: Kubo returns before Oyarzabal's scheduled preseason return
evidence.summary: Temporary preseason availability differences provide no basis for promoting Kubo into the hierarchy.

verdict.summary: Akor Adams has left. Isaac Romero and Ruben Vargas cannot inherit places automatically, although Isaac is the best-evidenced candidate.

clubs.recommended_notes: The hierarchy is unresolved. Isaac Romero is the leading candidate, not a confirmed primary.

evidence.title: Akor Adams converts with other candidates involved
evidence.summary: Akor converted against Atlético with Isaac Romero and Ruben Vargas involved, strongly confirming Akor's former precedence.

evidence.title: Akor Adams joins Venezia
evidence.summary: The permanent move removes Akor from the 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: Isaac Romero has a prior converted penalty
evidence.summary: Isaac's prior conversion makes him a candidate but does not prove the current primary role.

evidence.title: Isaac's attacking importance noted without penalty assignment
evidence.summary: Current reporting described Isaac's role in attack but did not assign him penalty responsibility.

verdict.summary: Largie Ramazani's loan ended. Hugo Duro took the latest two identified league penalties, independently supporting him above Pepelu.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved. Recheck if Ramazani completes a new move back to Valencia.

evidence.title: Largie Ramazani converts during his loan
evidence.summary: Ramazani converted against Espanyol while registered on a season-long loan.

evidence.title: Hugo Duro converts against Alavés
evidence.summary: Duro converted a regular-time penalty, providing role evidence independent of Ramazani's later departure.

evidence.title: Hugo Duro takes the later penalty at San Mamés
evidence.summary: Duro took and missed the later league penalty. The same review documented earlier misses by Pepelu and Ramazani, confirming multiple takers but Duro as the latest.

evidence.title: Ramazani joins on a season-long loan
evidence.summary: The official terms covered only the 2025/26 season. No completed return transfer was found by the audit cutoff.

verdict.summary: Gerard Moreno remains primary and Nicolas Pépé remains a current candidate. Daniel Parejo's farewell penalty occurred with Gerard absent and Parejo has since left.

clubs.recommended_notes: The third position is unresolved.

evidence.title: Gerard Moreno takes the latest pre-finale penalty
evidence.summary: Gerard took the latest listed penalty before the final match, supporting his retention as primary.

evidence.title: Daniel Parejo takes a farewell penalty
evidence.summary: Parejo took the final-day penalty with Gerard absent from the match record. The event therefore does not supersede Gerard.

evidence.title: Parejo's departure marked after the final match
evidence.summary: The club's farewell removes Parejo from the 2026/27 hierarchy.

evidence.title: Nicolas Pépé contracted through 2028
evidence.summary: Pépé's continuing contract supports retaining him as a current candidate, although direct evidence for a fixed second-choice role remains limited.

source_hubs_checked.purpose: Supporting event history and player status

limitations: The audit was performed during preseason, before the first 2026/27 competitive match.
Unresolved slots are represented by JSON null and are not automatic promotions from the filed hierarchy.
Current transfer situations and late preseason friendlies can change the hierarchy after the audit cutoff.
Penalty-shootout attempts were excluded from hierarchy decisions.
